🧠 Paste a brief — auto-fill targeting (beta — click to expand)

Pick Region + Campaign first, then paste your promo brief below. Use labels the tool understands — Networks:, Genres:, Shows:, Pluto Categories:, Pluto Channels:, Audience:, Ratings: (values comma- or line-separated). Exact matches are added to the fields automatically; close matches are suggested for you to confirm; anything unmatched is flagged.

✨ Suggest targeting (brief + AI + historicals; click to expand)

No show/channel list yet? Give the title — optionally add a description and/or paste a brief — and the tool proposes comp shows, Pluto channels, genres and Pluto categories, all matched to real FreeWheel inventory. It layers every signal you give it (brief, AI, and what similar past campaigns in this region actually ran) and ranks by agreement, so values confirmed by more sources come first. The comp shows populate the Showlist (which feeds both Tier 2 and the Tier 1 DDA audience segments). Pick Region below first — suggestions are region-specific.

The middle of every placement name — use it for the season, launch beat, or campaign messaging.

Time optional — leave blank to end at 11:59 PM.
Type a number and press Enter. Common: 30, 15, 60.

Products

Each toggle is preset to this brand's standard set — every product that gets built is shown as Yes. Switch any to No to leave it out. Only the products this campaign can run appear.

Add-ons

Optional Video Domination + takeover.

Pluto VD is built & pushed to FreeWheel automatically (list the Pluto categories below). Standard / 10 Streaming / My5 VDs run in Operative (no API) — they are not automated; you push them manually.
All takeovers (HPTO / FITO / Arena / 3-Peat) run in Operative — they are not automated; you push them manually per the Case instructions.
⚠️ Manual push required. This add-on runs in Operative, not FreeWheel. Follow the push instructions in the Case (copy the referenced Operative order → rename → set flight dates → get the 2× approvals → Push All to GAM). The automation does not book or push this for you.
Pluto TV UK / CA / USA only. Placements are added into the existing Scene Lifts – {Region} IO under the Pluto campaign; the promoted title + its audience are still excluded.
Builds one platform-wide placement per duration (video) + a pause placement at the Standard priorities, instead of the tier stack. Still excludes the promoted title + audience.

Targeting

Type to search — pick from the real FreeWheel list (no free text). Categories & channels are for the selected Region. Audience Segments (Tier 1) auto-resolve from the Showlist; leave blank.

This is a Pluto campaign — add the specific Pluto channels / categories below to target that inventory directly. Left blank, the lines run across the whole Pluto platform (broadest reach).
Channel 5 only — pick the My5 endpoints to run on (e.g. SG: Stream Type: VOD: My5, SG: My5 Channels: UK: MTV Owned). AND-ed into every tier. Leave blank to use the default (Adults: VOD; Kids: VOD + Milkshake).
Restrict the promo to only the selected rating(s) — the rating VG is added as an AND on every placement/argument, so it runs only where content matches. Region-based options, same as the Region's rating list.
Category / channel options are for the selected Region.
Tier 1 is standard across all markets. Usually left blank (auto-resolved from the showlist) — add specific DDA segments only if needed.

Geo — narrow to states / DMAs / cities (optional — click to expand; rarely used)
Leave blank to run across the whole region. Anything added here is layered on top of the region's country targeting (added to include) on every placement.
City names are ambiguous, so include the state: Chicago, IL. Must belong to the region.
Exclude instead — run everywhere except the geos below (can combine with the includes above).

Exclude from all placements

Keep the promo from running inside a title or channel. The promoted title is excluded automatically — add any extra series or Pluto channels here and they're excluded on every placement in the order.

For movies (single video assets, not series). Paste the FreeWheel Video ID — excluded on every placement. Type the ID and press Enter.
Keep the promo OUT of an existing DDA audience segment — excluded on every placement, in every relationship. Type-to-search the real segment.
Exclude content of the selected rating(s) — resolves to this market's VG: Content Rating: {region}: {rating} Video Groups and excludes them on every placement. Options are the ratings that exist for the selected Region.

Duplicate to another market

Building the same title in other countries? Pick the target markets — each gets the same creative & targeting, re-pointed at that country's equivalent brand, with naming and placements re-derived. Fill this plan out first, then download a plan file per market.
